title: Human subthalamic nucleus LFP during a stop-signal task (STN delta; Szabo et al.; derivative, 250 Hz)
description: Intraoperative local field potentials recorded with microelectrodes from the subthalamic nucleus of 13 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while they performed a stop-signal reaction time task. This derivative release contains the authors' continuous 250 Hz filtered LFP (0.5 Hz high-pass version), repackaged in BIDS-iEEG with BrainVision files and event annotations. It supports analyses of delta-frequency activity during action cancellation.
methods_description: Intraoperative STN microelectrode LFP was recorded during DBS implantation while patients performed a stop-signal task. The authors' EEGLAB files at 250 Hz were high-pass filtered (0.5 or 2 Hz) and notch-filtered or cleaned. The 0.5 Hz versions were repackaged as BrainVision float32 µV with unchanged values, and EEGLAB annotations were converted to events.tsv.
